welcome.title: Welcome to SpeakCore
welcome.body: In a few steps you'll set up your SpeakCore instance and create the owner account. No voice servers are installed yet.

mode.title: Choose system mode
mode.body: You can change this mode later.
mode.simpleDesc: Guided and focused on the essentials – recommended to get started.
mode.expertDesc: More detail and overrides for experienced administrators.

account.title: Create owner account
account.body: This account has full control over SpeakCore.
account.passwordHint: At least {min} characters, with upper- and lowercase letters and a digit.

errors.ownerExists: An account already exists. Setup cannot be run again.
errors.locked: Setup is locked (SETUP_LOCK). No owner can be created.
errors.emailInvalid: Please enter a valid email address.
errors.passwordWeak: The password does not meet the requirements.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please try again later.

login.title: Sign in
login.body: Sign in with your owner account.
login.rateLimited: Too many sign-in attempts. Please try again later.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.placeholderHint: Voice server management will follow in a later step.
